product_metadata.title: HPD Half Price Drapes Bellino Room Darkening Curtain 50 X 120 (1 Panel), BOCH-PL1701-120, Vista Grey
features: How To Hang: Our most versatile header allows you to hang 3 ways. Curtain panels can be sheered on a rod using the pocket, Hang with back tabs for a fixed ripple look or attached to rings using the belt and drapery pins. The Pole Pocket will accommodate a pole up to 1.5 inches in diameter, Hooks Not Included.

What You Get: Once purchased you will receive ONE PANEL (1), measuring 50 inches (127 cm) wide by 120 inches (304.8 cm) in length. Each panel will be individually bagged to preserve the fabric quality. Choose the right curtain length with our Measuring Guide, See below.

Light Control: This unlined curtain panel is considered Room Darkening, blocking anywhere from 75-94.9% of the light. Darker colors will always block more of the light while lighter colors let more of the light through.
Color & Texture: This Vista Grey color is a perfect choice for your home decor. This curtain is unlined and weighted hem.
Keep It Clean: The curtains should be dry cleaned only. Fold lines can be steamed out using a iron or garment steamer. Avoid making contact with the face fabric.
description: We've improved upon our already popular Room Darkening Curtain Collection by introducing an Exclusive Bellino Room Darkening Curtain Collection. The fabric has a soft, yard dyed texture and comes as Pole Pocket with Back Tabs and Hookbelt. These curtains keep the light out and provides optimal thermal insulation. As a general rule, for proper fullness panels should measure 2-3 times the width of your window/opening.
